mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where INDPRO drops by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive or neutral in > 40% of instances where RSAFS declines over three consecutive months.
